predecessors.name: Landgraviate of Hesse
predecessors.text: 'Philip I ... split his large landgraviate into four parts, Hesse-Marburg being one of them'; 'the city of Marburg and the surrounding towns of Gießen, Nidda and Eppstein'

successors.name: Landgraviate of Hesse-Kassel
successors.text: 'Hesse-Kassel taking the northern and Hesse-Darmstadt the southern part' (Marburg to Kassel)

successors.name: Landgraviate of Hesse-Darmstadt
successors.text: 'he bequeathed equal shares of his territory to the landgraviates of' Hesse-Kassel (Marburg) and Hesse-Darmstadt (Gießen, Nidda)

ledger.x: 1604: the end of Hesse-Marburg (infobox 1567-1604; the text: 'between 1567 and 1604/1650').

certainty.note: The page names four towns and no boundary or area; the circles are stand-ins.
